title: Russian-Style Skillet Stuffed Peppers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Kabanos
ingredients.notes: use as a substitute for sausage

instructions: Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds.
In the skillet, sauté the mushrooms, onion, and kabanos until the onion is translucent.
Add the sauerkraut and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Stuff each pepper with the skillet mixture and place them in a baking dish.
Cover the peppers with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
